_about: Your own ASR correction table. Merges key by key with the profile's table: a pair the profile does not have is added, and a pair it does have is overridden by this one. Longer keys win, so a specific phrase is replaced before a shorter key can eat part of it.

_sections.deterministic: Applied automatically. Only put a pair here when the wrong form is never a legitimate word in the lectures you actually watch.
_sections.context_sensitive: Never applied automatically. Listed so a human or an LLM can judge each occurrence.
